items.prompt:
Use case: compositing / ads-marketing.
Create one finished square marketplace product-family cover for PM.MARKET, preferably 1680 × 1680. Input 1 is the approved PM.MARKET art-direction reference ONLY: clean white background, huge dusty rose type, ink black text, delicate pink outlined feature cards, real product dominant on the right, fine rose footer line. Do not include its jar or Silk Way wording. Input 2 is the EXACT owner product photograph: preserve the brown BROVI × ЗАВИСИМОСТЬ Cool Light Brown bottle's physical shape, black ribbed cap, dark label, brown liquid and real printed lettering; this is a representative bottle of the family. Make it a beautifully lit large hero on the right, slightly angled with a soft realistic shadow. Do not replace or redesign the package label, and do not write ONE onto the bottle.
This is a family cover for the actual BROVI ONE range, not a particular shade. The range contains nine shades and two correctors; selectable volumes 5 and 10 ml. Use only these truthful advertising features.
Exact overlay copy, all spelled correctly:
small black top heading "ПИГМЕНТЫ ДЛЯ ПМУ"
large rose headline "BROVI ONE"
black short subheading "МИНЕРАЛЬНАЯ СЕРИЯ"
three clear left-side feature cards with simple line icons:
"9 ОТТЕНКОВ" and underneath "ПАЛИТРА НА ВЫБОР"
"2 КОРРЕКТОРА" and underneath "КРАСНЫЙ И ОХРИСТО-ЖЁЛТЫЙ"
"5 И 10 МЛ" and underneath "ВЫБЕРИТЕ НУЖНЫЙ ОБЪЁМ"
small footer "БРОВИ • ПИГМЕНТЫ"
Aim for the same restrained but persuasive premium marketplace style as reference 1. Strong clear hierarchy, plenty of white space, mobile-readable type, polished product photography. All overlays must remain outside the bottle and readable. Only one bottle, no extra cosmetic props or colour swatches presented as exact colour evidence.
Do not add any other claim or copy. Specifically no percentages, healing retention, duration, minimum corrections, medical or safety guarantees, all-technique claims, certificates, ISO, ГОСТ, ECO, country of manufacture, vegan claims, stars, reviews, discounts or prices. No decorative numbering. Do not imply all nine colours are for eyebrows: the family includes an eyelid black. Do not use the old unsupported benefit badges. Preserve the owner's exact old package, do not substitute a contemporary new package.
